page_title: VAL 1-1 ESP | Valencia v Espanyol 22/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' A player from Espanyol commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Javi Puado leaves the pitch and Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) comes on.
86' Rafa Mir (Valencia) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Joan Garcia easily deals with the threat.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pepelu (Valencia) comes onto the pitch so that Enzo Barrenechea can be given a rest.
84' Carlos Corberan prepares a substitution. Diego Lopez is replaced by Fran Perez (Valencia).
83' A substitution has been made. Pol Lozano is replaced by Alex Kral (Espanyol).

82' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Rafa Mir (Valencia), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
81' Valencia fail to score from a corner as Joan Garcia (Espanyol) leaps to collect the ball.

80' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Joan Garcia dived superbly to block a header by Jose Gaya (Valencia) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the top right corner, but Joan Garcia pulled off a save!
78' One of the players from Espanyol times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
77' The corner is swung in but Valencia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
75' Juan Pulido interrupts the game. One of the players from Espanyol won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
73' A cross from a corner kick by Espanyol is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
71' Juan Pulido blows his whistle after Pol Lozano (Espanyol) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Valencia are awarded a free kick.
70' Here is a change. Exposito is going off and Manolo Gonzalez gives the last tactical orders to Pere Milla (Espanyol).
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) for Jofre.
68' A pass by Javi Puado (Espanyol) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
66' The ball is behind the touchline and Valencia will take a throw-in.
65' The current number of shots on goal is 5:2.
62' The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
60' Valencia are seeing far more of the ball now.
57' 1 - 1 Goal! Javi Guerra (Valencia) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
54' Substitution. Rafa Mir (Valencia) has come on for Andre Almeida.
52' The referee blows his whistle, Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
51' Exposito (Espanyol) swings in a cross from the corner, but Giorgi Mamardashvili reads it well and gathers the ball.
50' The linesman makes the right call and Valencia will have a corner.
48' The ball goes out of play. Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
46' Juan Pulido blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
45+2' The foul by Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Juan Pulido.
45+1' A lofted ball into the centre of the box is met with a forceful header by Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol), but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Javi Guerra (Valencia) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Joan Garcia is prepared to thwart his effort.
40' 0 - 1 Javi Puado (Espanyol) wins the ball inside the penalty area after the free kick and scores with a precise shot into the bottom left corner!
39' Andre Almeida (Valencia) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Juan Pulido didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
37' Luis Rioja (Valencia) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
35' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The linesman signals a throw-in for Espanyol.

34' Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
33' Javi Guerra (Valencia) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
31' A yellow card for a tackle by Carlos Romero (Espanyol). Juan Pulido doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
29' Good work from Valencia as they win a corner.
28' Hugo Duro (Valencia) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes over the bar.
26' Jose Gaya (Valencia) brings an opponent down and Juan Pulido interrupts the game. Espanyol are awarded the free kick.
24' The ball has crossed the sideline. Valencia are taking a throw-in.
22' Javi Puado (Espanyol) sends a cross into the box, but Giorgi Mamardashvili comes off his line to gather the ball.
20' Looks like Joan Garcia (Espanyol) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
17' POST! Exposito (Espanyol) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was!
17' It looks like Pol Lozano (Espanyol) saw red with that tackle. Juan Pulido won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
16' The percentage of ball possession is – 49:51.

12' Unbelievable miss! Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
11' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Valencia in a dangerous position.
9' The ball goes behind for a corner. Espanyol will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
8' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Espanyol.
6' Hugo Duro (Valencia) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the right post, but Joan Garcia is prepared and dives to thwart him.
5' Some patient build-up play from Valencia as they look to unlock the defence.
2' That's unlucky! Carlos Romero (Espanyol) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
1' The match has just started.
Espanyol will kick the game off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Juan Pulido will referee today's match.
